2: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am faint. Lord, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
4: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Lord -how long?
5: Return, Lord. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness' sake.
6: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
7: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
8: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
9: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
10: The Lord has heard my supplication. The Lord accepts my prayer.
11: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
